events.event: IHSG closed up 1.12% at 5,387.91 for a third straight gain after opening about 2% lower, while foreign investors net sold about Rp1.49 trillion.
events.key_numbers: Close 5,387.91 (+59.54 pts, +1.12%) · open 5,247.98 · intraday high 5,422.59 · 21 Oct close 5,328 (+0.94%) · foreign net sell Rp1.49 T (BBCA Rp624.6 B, TLKM Rp332.2 B, BBRI Rp257.9 B) · value Rp15.3-16.2 T (sources differ)
events.why_it_matters: The index is bouncing off its decade low but foreigners are still selling, so the recovery is domestic-driven and fragile.
events.spreading_evidence: Dominates CNBC Indonesia and detik market headlines

events.event: Bank Indonesia held the BI-Rate at 5.75% at its October RDG but raised the Deposit Facility rate to 5%, citing rupiah pressure, global uncertainty and tight US monetary policy.
events.key_numbers: BI-Rate 5.75% (hold) · Deposit Facility 5.00% (+25 bp) · Lending Facility 6.50% unchanged · Sept inflation 3.28% y/y (core 2.88%, volatile food 5.03%) · bank credit +13.21% y/y (investment credit +23.2%) · 2026 growth range 4.9-5.7%
events.why_it_matters: Polls leaned to a hike, but BI chose a quieter lever: the loan rate stays, while the floor rate banks earn on parked money rises.
events.spreading_evidence: Multiple outlets, detik photo/news headlines on 21 Oct

events.event: The rupiah weakened past Rp18,000 per US dollar after Bank Indonesia held its policy rate.
events.key_numbers: Reported closes Rp18,022 and Rp18,060 per USD (outlets differ) · morning level Rp18,083 · 20 Oct close Rp17,995 (E0172)
events.why_it_matters: Rp18,000 is a psychological line that makes imports, fuel and overseas tuition costlier.

events.event: OJK and Bareskrim detailed sanctions totalling Rp2.1 trillion in the DSSA, BREN and CUAN share cases, fining a market-manipulation customer and entities that hid the identities of share buyers.
events.key_numbers: DSSA: PT SMT fined Rp1.5 T, nine brokers fined, one licence suspended 1 year · BREN: AH Ltd fined Rp500 B · CUAN: TC Pte Ltd fined Rp100 B, two brokers fined, one licence suspended 3 months · total Rp2.1 T
events.why_it_matters: These stock-concentration cases are the core of MSCI's complaint about free float and transparency.

events.event: President Prabowo said Indonesia is not afraid of MSCI, and OJK's chief responded, as Airlangga called the market tremors not disruptive and MSCI's timeline runs to a June 2027 final decision.
events.key_numbers: MSCI consultation until Apr 2027 · final decision by 30 Jun 2027 · IHSG 21 Oct close 5,328
events.why_it_matters: The president is now publicly part of the MSCI fight, which changes how markets and regulators will react.

events.event: Manpower Minister Yassierli said the 2027 minimum wage formula will follow the new labour law and no percentage is set, while unions propose a 7.5-9.5% rise.
events.key_numbers: Union proposal 7.5-9.5% · union formula (inflation 3.20% + growth 5.43%) x index 0.9 = about 7.8% (our calc) · PP 49/2025 index 0.5-0.9 · new labour law passed by DPR 6 Oct · union protests 15-30 Oct in 38 provinces · wage setting reported scheduled around 1 Nov
events.why_it_matters: It decides how much monthly pay rises for millions of minimum-wage workers next year.
events.spreading_evidence: detikFinance headline, CNBC, CNN, Bisnis all ran it 21-22 Oct

events.event: Coordinating Minister Airlangga said the government has prepared about Rp31.8 trillion for a wage subsidy (BSU), rice aid and a Christmas-New Year transport discount running through end-2026.
events.key_numbers: Total Rp31.8 T · rice aid 10 kg per recipient (reported as 10 kg for 3 months, extended to year-end) · per-programme amounts and eligibility not stated
events.why_it_matters: Direct handouts and discounts are meant to prop up household spending in the last quarter.

events.event: Energy Minister Bahlil said the government is considering not extending gas exports to neighbouring countries so domestic needs come first, following Prabowo's 'survival mode' call at a cabinet plenary.
events.key_numbers: Volumes, destinations and contract dates not stated · described as an option, not a decision
events.why_it_matters: Cutting gas exports would hit export earnings and neighbours such as Singapore, while energy security tightens at home.

events.event: The government reiterated that Pertalite will not rise in price despite surging oil prices, after Deputy Energy Minister Yuliot said subsidised fuel prices are held through year-end.
events.key_numbers: Oil about US$107 per barrel (end-Sep, US-Iran tension) · Brent about US$108-110 mid-Oct (E0127, E0174) · Pertalite and Biosolar price unchanged to end-2026 · Pertalite stock 16-18 days (E0128)
events.why_it_matters: Frozen pump prices protect wallets but push the subsidy bill and supply strain higher.

events.event: BBNI is scheduled to report Q3 2026 results on 23 October, with BMRI 27 Oct, BRIS 29 Oct and BBRI/BBTN/BDMN 30 Oct to follow amid the market sell-off.
events.key_numbers: BBNI 23 Oct · BMRI 27 Oct · BRIS 29 Oct · BBRI, BBTN, BDMN 30 Oct · Fed meeting 28 Oct
events.why_it_matters: Bank earnings show whether the sell-off is hitting real profits or only share prices.
